authority.source_authority: DAD owns its family registry, schemas, generated candidate projections, and cockpit contract; every source repository retains its own meaning and adoption authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only portfolio-family-builder may edit the implementation worktree. All delegated specialists and the independent checker are read-only and return evidence to the writer.

roles.why_needed: One integration owner must preserve schema, registry, graph, routing, CLI, cockpit, and test coherence.
roles.mission: Validate and commit the ML family, then implement the shared model-neutral family control plane, full-stack and six portfolio families, legal overlay, DAD and Mock Trial pilots, cockpit projection, and deterministic tests.
inputs: existing DAD registries, graph, cockpit, and governance contracts
roles.authority: May write only the isolated DAD worktree; may not mutate pilot repositories, install global skills, create automations, publish, or promote candidate guidance.
acceptance_conditions: All new structured artifacts validate and replay deterministically.
Routing activates the smallest sufficient family set and enforces checker independence.
Cockpit exposes no more than three immediate human decisions and has no execution authority.
DAD and Mock Trial pilots use metadata-only local evidence and do not mutate either source repository.
Repository validation, roadmap checks, and task-relevant tests pass.
stop_conditions: A change requires writing outside the isolated DAD worktree.
A generated relationship would be treated as reviewed truth or execution authority.
A legal, privacy, security, release, or external mutation decision lacks Lowell's approval.
Existing user changes overlap incompatibly with the implementation scope.

readiness_conditions: Writer checks pass and source-authority boundaries are explicit.

roles.why_needed: The existing cockpit has a strict read-only attention contract that must not be bypassed by the new family projection.
roles.mission: Inspect the current cockpit and graph implementation and return bounded integration points, compatibility risks, and tests without editing files.
roles.authority: Read-only specialist; no file, Git, runtime, or external writes.
acceptance_conditions: Names exact integration surfaces and compatibility constraints.
Identifies tests for top-three decisions, deduplication, and candidate-only authority.
stop_conditions: The brief would require modifying the worktree or inspecting private source rows.

readiness_conditions: Findings cite repository paths and observable contracts.

roles.why_needed: DAD requires reuse-first discovery and a separate check for duplicate assets, missing harnesses, and pay-forward lessons.
roles.mission: Inspect the proposed implementation against DAD's existing asset, skill, harness, and learning surfaces and report reuse, duplication, and validation opportunities without editing files.
roles.authority: Read-only specialist; no file, Git, runtime, or external writes.
acceptance_conditions: Reports concrete reuse candidates and likely duplicate concepts.
Proposes falsifiable harness checks and bounded pay-forward lessons.
stop_conditions: The review would require copying private payloads or promoting candidate guidance.

readiness_conditions: Findings are privacy-safe, deduplicated, and tied to repository evidence.

roles.why_needed: A high-risk shared contract and graph implementation requires fresh-eyes verification independent of the writer.
roles.mission: Re-derive the acceptance contract, inspect the final diff and evidence, and red-team authority, privacy, routing minimality, graph direction, stale deduplication, cockpit limits, compatibility, and missing tests.
roles.authority: Read-only independent checker; cannot edit, promote, approve external adoption, or replace human release authority.
acceptance_conditions: Returns prioritized findings with exact evidence and an explicit release recommendation.
Independently checks material acceptance obligations rather than trusting the writer summary.
stop_conditions: Checker independence is compromised or raw evidence is unavailable.

readiness_conditions: Final diff and machine-checkable evidence are available.

proof_obligations.description: Prove role contracts use capability tiers and runtime constraints rather than permanent provider model identifiers.
Prove monitoring produces deduplicated candidate evidence and cannot rewrite active guidance or external systems.
Prove the cockpit projects family coverage, health, evidence, freshness, risks, and at most three immediate human decisions without execution authority.
Prove DAD and Mock Trial pilots consume metadata-only evidence and do not mutate source repositories or claim legal authority.
